description: Find the account that shared a TikTok link, from a short share link copied in the app. It works unless the sharer turned off account suggestions, and share links can expire. Costs 1 credit (or one of a pack's free daily tool searches); finding nothing or failing costs nothing.

include_raw.description: Return everything each source sent instead of the main fields. Much longer; off by default.

max_wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before returning what has arrived so far (default 50). The tool keeps running on OSINT.SX after that, so its credit may still be used.

url.description: The short share link, as copied from the TikTok app.

name: tiktok_share_trace
title: TikTok share link trace
